author: Codex original Archive production lane
medium: Original editable Canvas2D vector paths, gradients, clipped pigmentation and articulated transforms; not a 3D model
reference_policy: Institutional text descriptions consulted for anatomy and habitat; no external image was traced, embedded or copied. Existing project whale field-plate geometry is retained and adapted with its original provenance.

taxa.interpretation: Stylized lateral/oblique blue whale, invented individual mottling, simplified ventral grooves, articulated tail/flippers

primary_references.used_for: Slender blue-gray mottled body and baleen-whale feeding anatomy
Small posterior dorsal, blunt flippers and ventral grooves

taxa.interpretation: Adult male yellow-gold lion with declared mane variation, compact muscular body, paws, counterbalancing tail and articulated walk

primary_references.used_for: Compact body, powerful forequarters, yellow-gold coat, adult male shaggy mane and grassland setting

taxa.interpretation: African savanna elephant study with large ears, swayed back, wrinkled skin, columnar feet, tusks and flexible trunk; not an Asian or forest-elephant substitute

primary_references.used_for: African elephant ear/back/trunk distinctions, visible tusks, wrinkled skin and ear-flapping behavior

taxa.interpretation: Dorsal/oblique adult monarch, orange fore/hindwings with black venation/borders and paired white spotting; no male scent-patch claim

primary_references.used_for: Monarch orange/black markings, white wing-border spotting and milkweed/flower habitat relationship

animation_limits: Cycles are authored educational movement cues driven by the existing observation timer, not measured kinematics or locomotion simulation.
No claim that four supported adult interpretations represent every sex, age, population or viewing angle.
Reduced-motion freezes articulation and authored habitat drift; unsupported taxa retain their existing honest provisional representation.
habitat_limits: Original composed ocean, savanna/watering-hole and milkweed-garden illustrations. No measured geography, occurrence density, paleogeography or habitat survey is claimed.

lifeling.basis: Existing fictional mint-bodied Lifeling with pointed ears, black eyes, optional earned mane/traits and current saved name; Living Archive jade/ivory/amber palette
lifeling.changes: Original soft contour and coat shading, belly/paw details, eye glints/blink/celebration expression, and drawn sparkle/sniff/dig feedback

rights: Original project source under the existing repository LICENSE. Institutional descriptions supply anatomical facts; no institutional photography, illustrations, trade dress or logos are included.
